description: A single-panel figure consisting of one table, Table 1, titled "Chemical compositions (wt%) of the studied low-density stee strips", rendered as plain text with a horizontal rule separating the header row from the two data rows. The header row reads, from left: "Samples", then six element columns "Mn", "Al", "Cr", "C", "Nb", "Fe". Row 1 is the sample "0.02Nb steel" with Mn 12.80, Al 9.01, Cr 3.01, C 1.39, Nb 0.021 and Fe Bal. Row 2 is the sample "0.04Nb steel" with Mn 12.82, Al 9.12, Cr 2.99, C 1.40, Nb 0.039 and Fe Bal. The two steels are therefore near-identical in Mn, Al, Cr and C, and differ essentially only in Nb (0.021 versus 0.039 wt%), which is the single deliberate compositional variable of the study. No axes, scale bars, legends or graphical data appear; the table supplies the alloy-design basis (nominally Fe-12Mn-9Al-3Cr-1.4C with 0.02 or 0.04 Nb) against which all microstructural, precipitation and mechanical results of the paper are interpreted, and it defines the two sample labels used in every other figure.

observations.observation: No graphical data are present; the single image is a table whose header row is 'Samples', 'Mn', 'Al', 'Cr', 'C', 'Nb', 'Fe', separated from the data rows by a horizontal rule.
The table lists exactly two alloys, labelled as printed '0.02Nb steel' and '0.04Nb steel'.
For '0.02Nb steel' the printed values are Mn 12.80, Al 9.01, Cr 3.01, C 1.39, Nb 0.021, Fe Bal.
For '0.04Nb steel' the printed values are Mn 12.82, Al 9.12, Cr 2.99, C 1.40, Nb 0.039, Fe Bal.
Nb is the only element differing appreciably between the two steels, 0.021 wt% versus 0.039 wt% (roughly a factor of two).
Mn (12.80 vs 12.82), Al (9.01 vs 9.12), Cr (3.01 vs 2.99) and C (1.39 vs 1.40) are essentially constant between the two heats, and Fe is given as the balance ('Bal.') in both.
Concentrations are reported to two decimal places for Mn, Al, Cr and C, three decimals for Nb, with no scatter or uncertainty columns.
The caption states that the values are chemical compositions in wt% of the studied low-density steel strips.
The caption title contains the spelling 'stee strips' (as printed) rather than 'steel strips'.

subfigures.description: A two-row, seven-column composition table in wt%. Columns: Samples, Mn, Al, Cr, C, Nb, Fe. Row 1: 0.02Nb steel — 12.80 Mn, 9.01 Al, 3.01 Cr, 1.39 C, 0.021 Nb, Fe Bal. Row 2: 0.04Nb steel — 12.82 Mn, 9.12 Al, 2.99 Cr, 1.40 C, 0.039 Nb, Fe Bal. The table is fully legible; no graphical elements are present.
